about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover TDV6 and SDV6 are 3.0-litre V6 diesel engines fitted across the L322 and L405 generations from 2001 to 2021. The TDV6 and SDV6 are part of the same engine family — the SDV6 is essentially a higher-output version of the TDV6, sharing the same fundamental architecture and components, including the well-documented timing chain and injector wear pattern. The current L460-generation Range Rover moved to the Ingenium I6 diesel family, which is a different engine design.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV6 or SDV6 (M57D30) engines for every Range Rover TDV6 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Range Rover from 2001 to 2021, across two generations. Known for timing chain tensioner wear and injector seal failure — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 and SDV6 rebuild.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: Because the Range Rover TDV6 and SDV6 share the same engine family across both the L322 and L405 generations, the rebuild process and components are consistent. However, the exact specification can vary between years. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (TDV6 or SDV6 (M57D30)) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
